prompt_head:
Job: Configuration Specialist II at CentralReach
<requirements>
- (required) 1–3 years of experience in a technical configuration, implementation, or SaaS opera

output.summary: Systems architect with 4+ years building full‑stack SaaS platforms and automation tools. Designed and deployed a Cloudflare Workers CRM module for high‑value subscription accounts. Built a LangGraph job‑fit agent that ingests public job postings via APIs and drafts tailored documents behind human approval. Constructed automated data‑validation pipelines that removed 98% of transactional and invoicing errors.

bullets.text: Architected and deployed linkme-intops, a React/TypeScript CRM on Cloudflare Workers for high-value subscription accounts.
Engineered custom data ingestion modules and analytics pipelines for VIP workflows, reducing service delivery times by over 30%.
Designed integration blueprints and live demo environments to reliably onboard high-value enterprise clients onto the core platform.
Built Job Fit Agent that ingested job postings via APIs and drafted tailored documents behind a human approval step.
Shipped the agent with FastAPI, a React/TypeScript dashboard, PostgreSQL, Docker, and GitHub Actions CI.
Enforced evidence-cited outputs with a deterministic verify loop and prompt-injection defense.
Engineered tycodes.dev on edge infrastructure with Cloudflare Workers, Vite, React, and TypeScript.
Constructed database-layer automated data validation pipelines that eliminated 98% of transactional and invoicing errors.
Led end-to-end modernization from legacy desktop systems to cloud-native web infrastructure, reducing manual data processing overhead by 68%.
Achieved top-performer status by securing 50+ qualified meetings per month and setting a record of 120+ meetings in a single month.
